request.style: English, Solo female voice, ethereal and resonant, harp, bodhran, low strings, cello, atmospheric pads, solemn and reflective, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Korah stand in the line
Assir and Elkanah and Abiasaph
Descendants of Levi in the clan
Holding the history in their hand

[Chorus]
The earth opened its mouth wide
Swallowing the rebels with pride
But the sons of Korah did not die
Sparing the lineage from the sky

[Verse]
Korah rose up against Moses
With two hundred and fifty men
They grumbled against God’s choice
Saying we are all holy then
Moses fell facedown in the dust
As the fire from the Lord burst
Consuming the incense and the proud
While the faithful were not allowed

[Chorus]
The earth opened its mouth wide
Swallowing the rebels with pride
But the sons of Korah did not die
Sparing the lineage from the sky

[Verse]
Abiasaph became a father
To Tahath in the Levitical way
His brother Asaph stood right hand
Singing praise for the holy day
The Korahites kept the gates
Serving where their souls were made
Through Abiasaph’s line descended
Heman, whose voice was blessed

[Chorus]
The earth opened its mouth wide
Swallowing the rebels with pride
But the sons of Korah did not die
Sparing the lineage from the sky

[Bridge]
Not all who rebel are lost
Not all who serve are crossed
The judgment fell on the sin
But the seed remained within

[Outro]
The sons of Korah did not die
The sons of Korah did not die
